subject.name: Calculus I
subject.description: Single-variable calculus for first-year engineering: limits, differentiation, integration, series, and an introduction to differential equations. Everything required to move on to second-year mathematics.

depth_levels.awareness: Know it exists and recognize it
depth_levels.procedural: Apply it mechanically to standard problems
depth_levels.fluency: Combine it with other tools in multi-step problems
depth_levels.proof: State it precisely and prove or derive it

topics.name: Precalculus Foundations
topics.description: Review gate: the algebra, functions, and trigonometry the whole course stands on.

subtopics.name: Functions, domain, and range
subtopics.description: Function notation, evaluating functions, finding domains and ranges.

subtopics.name: Composite and inverse functions
subtopics.description: Building and decomposing composite functions; existence and computation of inverses.

subtopics.name: Polynomial and rational functions and their graphs
subtopics.description: Roots, factoring, end behavior, asymptote intuition for rational functions.

subtopics.name: Exponential and logarithmic functions and their properties
subtopics.description: Laws of exponents and logarithms, solving exponential/log equations, graphs.

subtopics.name: Trigonometric functions and the unit circle
subtopics.description: Radian measure, the six trig functions, exact values, periodicity, graphs.

subtopics.name: Fundamental trigonometric identities
subtopics.description: Pythagorean, sum/difference, double-angle, half-angle identities.

subtopics.name: Inverse trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: Definitions, restricted domains, principal values, graphs.

subtopics.name: Solving equations and inequalities
subtopics.description: Algebraic, absolute-value, and sign-chart methods for inequalities.

subtopics.name: Absolute value and piecewise-defined functions
subtopics.description: Working with piecewise definitions; |x| as a piecewise function.

subtopics.name: Shifting, scaling, and reflecting graphs
subtopics.description: Recognizing f(x−a)+b, cf(x), f(cx), −f(x), f(−x) transformations.

topics.name: Limits and Continuity
topics.description: The foundational concept of calculus: limiting behavior of functions and what it means to be continuous.

subtopics.name: The intuitive idea of a limit; numerical and graphical estimation
subtopics.description: Reading limits off graphs and tables; when limits fail to exist.

subtopics.name: One-sided limits
subtopics.description: Left- and right-hand limits and their relation to two-sided limits.

subtopics.name: Limit laws and algebraic evaluation of limits
subtopics.description: Sum/product/quotient laws; factoring, conjugates, and simplification tricks.

subtopics.name: The squeeze (sandwich) theorem
subtopics.description: Bounding a function to force a limit; classic oscillation examples.

subtopics.name: Special trigonometric limits
subtopics.description: sin(x)/x → 1 and (1−cos x)/x → 0, and limits built from them.

subtopics.name: Infinite limits and vertical asymptotes
subtopics.description: Limits that grow without bound; locating vertical asymptotes.

subtopics.name: Limits at infinity and horizontal asymptotes
subtopics.description: End behavior of rational, exponential, and root functions.

subtopics.name: The precise (epsilon–delta) definition of a limit
subtopics.description: Formal definition; writing epsilon–delta proofs for simple limits.

subtopics.name: Continuity at a point and on an interval
subtopics.description: The three-part definition; continuity of standard function classes.

subtopics.name: Classifying discontinuities
subtopics.description: Removable, jump, and infinite discontinuities; repairing removable ones.

subtopics.name: The Intermediate Value Theorem and its applications
subtopics.description: Statement, hypotheses, and using the IVT to locate roots.

topics.name: The Derivative: Definition and Basic Rules
topics.description: What a derivative is, and the core rules for computing derivatives of algebraic functions.

subtopics.name: Average versus instantaneous rate of change
subtopics.description: Secant vs tangent slopes; rates of change in physical contexts.

subtopics.name: The derivative as a limit of difference quotients
subtopics.description: Computing derivatives from the definition; where derivatives fail to exist.

subtopics.name: Tangent lines and slopes of curves
subtopics.description: Finding equations of tangent lines at a point.

subtopics.name: Differentiability and its relation to continuity
subtopics.description: Corners, cusps, vertical tangents; differentiable implies continuous.

subtopics.name: The derivative as a function; higher-order derivatives
subtopics.description: Sketching f′ from f; second and higher derivatives.

subtopics.name: Derivative notations and their meaning
subtopics.description: Leibniz (dy/dx), Lagrange (f′), and dot notation; when each is used.

subtopics.name: The power rule
subtopics.description: Differentiating x^n for integer, rational, and real exponents.

subtopics.name: Constant multiple and sum/difference rules
subtopics.description: Linearity of differentiation; differentiating polynomials.

subtopics.name: The product rule
subtopics.description: Statement, use, and derivation of the product rule.

subtopics.name: The quotient rule
subtopics.description: Statement and use; deriving it from the product rule.

topics.name: Chain Rule and Derivatives of Transcendental Functions
topics.description: Differentiating compositions and the trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic families.

subtopics.name: The chain rule
subtopics.description: Differentiating composite functions, including nested compositions.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of the six trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: d/dx of sin, cos, tan, cot, sec, csc; deriving sin′ from special limits.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of exponential functions and the number e
subtopics.description: Why e is special; differentiating e^x and a^x.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of logarithmic functions
subtopics.description: Differentiating ln x and log_a x, including composite arguments.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: d/dx of arcsin, arccos, arctan and friends.

subtopics.name: Hyperbolic functions and their derivatives
subtopics.description: sinh, cosh, tanh: definitions, identities, derivatives.

subtopics.name: Differentiating functions that combine all rule families
subtopics.description: Fluently choosing and combining product, quotient, and chain rules.

topics.name: Advanced Differentiation Techniques
topics.description: Differentiation beyond y = f(x): implicit relations, parametric curves, and logarithmic tricks.

subtopics.name: Implicit differentiation
subtopics.description: Differentiating relations like x² + y² = 25; finding dy/dx implicitly.

subtopics.name: Logarithmic differentiation
subtopics.description: Differentiating products, quotients, and f(x)^g(x) via logarithms.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of inverse functions
subtopics.description: The formula (f⁻¹)′(b) = 1/f′(a) and its geometric meaning.

subtopics.name: Derivatives of parametric curves
subtopics.description: dy/dx and d²y/dx² for curves given by x(t), y(t).

subtopics.name: Tangent and normal lines to implicit and parametric curves
subtopics.description: Applying implicit/parametric derivatives to find tangent and normal lines.

subtopics.name: Second derivatives of implicit relations
subtopics.description: Computing d²y/dx² implicitly and simplifying with the original relation.

topics.name: Applications of Derivatives I: Analysis of Functions
topics.description: Using derivatives to understand the shape and behavior of functions, and the classical theorems behind it.

subtopics.name: Absolute and local extrema; critical points
subtopics.description: Finding and classifying critical points; closed-interval method.

subtopics.name: The Extreme Value Theorem
subtopics.description: Statement and hypotheses; why continuity on a closed interval matters.

subtopics.name: Rolle's Theorem
subtopics.description: Statement, geometric meaning, and applications to roots of f′.

subtopics.name: The Mean Value Theorem and its consequences
subtopics.description: Statement and proof from Rolle's; consequences (f′=0 implies constant).

subtopics.name: Monotonicity and the first derivative test
subtopics.description: Increasing/decreasing intervals; classifying extrema from sign of f′.

subtopics.name: Concavity, inflection points, and the second derivative test
subtopics.description: Reading concavity from f″; inflection points; second derivative test.

subtopics.name: Complete curve sketching
subtopics.description: Combining domain, asymptotes, monotonicity, and concavity into a full sketch.

subtopics.name: Indeterminate forms and L'Hôpital's rule
subtopics.description: 0/0, ∞/∞, and the algebraic conversions for 0·∞, ∞−∞, 1^∞, 0⁰, ∞⁰.

subtopics.name: Newton's method for approximating roots
subtopics.description: The iteration formula, geometric picture, and failure cases.

topics.name: Applications of Derivatives II: Modelling and Problem Solving
topics.description: Derivatives applied to real-world quantities: optimization, related rates, approximation, and motion.

subtopics.name: Related rates problems
subtopics.description: Linking rates of change of related quantities via implicit differentiation.

subtopics.name: Linearization and differentials
subtopics.description: Tangent-line approximation; using dy to estimate change.

subtopics.name: Using derivatives to solve real-world optimization problems
subtopics.description: Setting up objective functions with constraints; verifying optima. The canonical example survey question.

subtopics.name: Marginal analysis and rate interpretations
subtopics.description: Marginal cost/revenue and other engineering/economic rate readings of f′.

subtopics.name: Rectilinear motion: position, velocity, acceleration
subtopics.description: Kinematics via derivatives; speed vs velocity; direction changes.

subtopics.name: Error propagation and sensitivity via differentials
subtopics.description: Absolute, relative, and percentage error estimates in measurements.

topics.name: Integration: Antiderivatives and the Definite Integral
topics.description: The second pillar of calculus: accumulating change, from Riemann sums to the Fundamental Theorem.

subtopics.name: Antiderivatives and the indefinite integral
subtopics.description: General antiderivatives, +C, and basic antiderivative formulas.

subtopics.name: Basic integration rules
subtopics.description: Power rule for integrals; antiderivatives of trig, exp, and 1/x.

subtopics.name: Sigma notation and summation formulas
subtopics.description: Manipulating finite sums; formulas for Σk, Σk², Σk³.

subtopics.name: The area problem and Riemann sums
subtopics.description: Left, right, and midpoint sums; approximating area under a curve.

subtopics.name: The definite integral as a limit of Riemann sums
subtopics.description: The formal definition; integrability of continuous functions.

subtopics.name: Properties of the definite integral
subtopics.description: Linearity, additivity over intervals, comparison properties, signed area.

subtopics.name: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, Part 1
subtopics.description: Differentiating accumulation functions; statement and proof.

subtopics.name: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, Part 2 (evaluation)
subtopics.description: Evaluating definite integrals with antiderivatives.

subtopics.name: The net change theorem and its interpretations
subtopics.description: Integral of a rate as net change; displacement vs distance traveled.

subtopics.name: Average value of a function and the Mean Value Theorem for integrals
subtopics.description: The average-value formula and its geometric meaning.

topics.name: Techniques of Integration
topics.description: The toolbox for finding antiderivatives of non-elementary combinations, plus numerical and improper integrals.

subtopics.name: Integration by substitution (u-substitution)
subtopics.description: Reversing the chain rule; substitution in definite integrals.

subtopics.name: Integration by parts
subtopics.description: Reversing the product rule; repeated and cyclic applications.

subtopics.name: Integrals of powers and products of trigonometric functions
subtopics.description: sinᵐx cosⁿx patterns; secant/tangent integrals; identity strategies.

subtopics.name: Trigonometric substitution
subtopics.description: Integrals with √(a²−x²), √(a²+x²), √(x²−a²) via trig substitutions.

subtopics.name: Integration by partial fraction decomposition
subtopics.description: Decomposing rational functions: linear, repeated, and quadratic factors.

subtopics.name: Rationalizing and other special substitutions
subtopics.description: Root substitutions and the Weierstrass (t = tan(x/2)) substitution.

subtopics.name: Choosing an integration strategy
subtopics.description: Recognizing which technique applies; combining techniques in one integral.

subtopics.name: Numerical integration: trapezoidal and Simpson's rules
subtopics.description: Approximating definite integrals; error bounds for each rule.

subtopics.name: Improper integrals and convergence
subtopics.description: Infinite limits of integration and unbounded integrands; comparison tests.

topics.name: Applications of Integration
topics.description: Definite integrals as a modelling tool: geometry, physics, and engineering quantities.

subtopics.name: Areas between curves
subtopics.description: Integrating with respect to x or y; regions requiring splitting.

subtopics.name: Volumes by slicing: disks and washers
subtopics.description: Solids of revolution and general cross-section solids.

subtopics.name: Volumes by cylindrical shells
subtopics.description: The shell method; choosing between shells and washers.

subtopics.name: Arc length of curves
subtopics.description: The arc-length integral for y = f(x) and parametric curves.

subtopics.name: Surface area of solids of revolution
subtopics.description: The surface-of-revolution integral.

subtopics.name: Work: springs, lifting, and pumping problems
subtopics.description: Work as an integral of force; Hooke's law and pumping problems.

subtopics.name: Moments and center of mass
subtopics.description: Centroids of plane regions via integrals.

subtopics.name: Physical applications: fluid force and pressure
subtopics.description: Hydrostatic force on submerged surfaces as an integral.

topics.name: Sequences and Series
topics.description: Infinite processes: convergence of sequences and series, and representing functions by power series.

subtopics.name: Sequences: convergence, monotonicity, and boundedness
subtopics.description: Limits of sequences; the monotone convergence theorem.

subtopics.name: Infinite series and partial sums; geometric and telescoping series
subtopics.description: Convergence via partial sums; summing geometric and telescoping series.

subtopics.name: The nth-term (divergence) test
subtopics.description: When terms don't go to zero; what the test cannot conclude.

subtopics.name: The integral test and p-series
subtopics.description: Linking series to improper integrals; convergence of Σ1/nᵖ.

subtopics.name: Direct and limit comparison tests
subtopics.description: Comparing to known series; choosing good comparison candidates.

subtopics.name: Alternating series, the alternating series test, and error bounds
subtopics.description: Leibniz test and estimating remainders of alternating series.

subtopics.name: Absolute versus conditional convergence
subtopics.description: Definitions, implications, and rearrangement caveats.

subtopics.name: The ratio and root tests
subtopics.description: Applying both tests; the inconclusive case.

subtopics.name: Power series: radius and interval of convergence
subtopics.description: Finding where a power series converges; endpoint analysis.

subtopics.name: Taylor and Maclaurin series
subtopics.description: Deriving series for eˣ, sin, cos, ln(1+x), (1+x)ᵏ; manipulation of known series.

subtopics.name: Taylor polynomials and the remainder estimate
subtopics.description: Approximating functions; Lagrange error bound.

subtopics.name: Using series for approximation, integration, and limits
subtopics.description: Series solutions to hard integrals and limits; approximation to a tolerance.

topics.name: Introduction to Differential Equations
topics.description: First contact with ODEs: qualitative pictures, separable and linear first-order equations, and growth models.

subtopics.name: What a differential equation is; verifying solutions
subtopics.description: Order, general vs particular solutions, initial conditions.

subtopics.name: Slope (direction) fields and qualitative behavior
subtopics.description: Sketching and reading slope fields; equilibrium solutions.

subtopics.name: Separable differential equations
subtopics.description: Solving by separation of variables; initial value problems.

subtopics.name: Exponential growth and decay models
subtopics.description: y′ = ky: population, radioactive decay, Newton's law of cooling, interest.

subtopics.name: The logistic growth model
subtopics.description: Carrying capacity; solving and interpreting the logistic equation.

subtopics.name: First-order linear equations and integrating factors
subtopics.description: The integrating-factor method for y′ + p(x)y = q(x).

subtopics.name: Euler's method for numerical solutions
subtopics.description: Step-by-step numerical approximation of ODE solutions.
